title: Alex Lutschaw, Barnes's cousin and student
summary: Reason says Barnes taught his cousin, who left music for a religious group.

blocks.x: Did you know Alex Luthschaw? Yeah, that's Paul's cousin. Which Paul? Paul Lee Barnes.
Oh, I see. I didn't know that. Oh, yeah.

Where is he from? New Orleans. Right now he lived close to Shelley Lamelle. And where did he play? He started, Paul was his teacher. Mm-hmm. Paul Barnes was his teacher. Then he joined a cult religion. Mm-hmm. He quit playing music and dance band. But he was playing, was Paul Barnes back.
